title: Delivered Status but GPS Location Mismatch

carrier_telemetry.carrier_exception_notes: GPS scan shows driver delivered 2.4 miles away at wrong street address

ticket.subject: Tracking says delivered but nothing is here
ticket.message: UPS tracking shows delivered at 3:30 PM today, but I was home and nothing was dropped off. I checked with my neighbors too.

ground_truth_verdict.policy_reasoning: Carrier telemetry confirms gps_match_address: False (misdelivered 2.4 miles away). Per Section 5, issue instant replacement and file back-office carrier misdelivery claim.
